_note: B3 trigger/behavior scenarios + the B4 validation layers. Routing cases complement evals/prompt-routing.json (the OD-L4 contract).

evals.setup: cwd is a full local checkout of a repo with GitHub Actions workflows
expected_behavior: Before collecting, confirms the scoring target as ONE structured question (AskUserQuestion where available) — the detected <owner/repo> (or checkout-root path) as the default option, 'a different repo or path' as the alternative — and does not run the collector until the target is settled
Runs collect_config.py against the checkout root and reads the ci_score stamp from the written findings.json
Renders the report to scratch with render_report.py and runs verify_report.py, surfacing nothing from it (and printing no repo path) until it prints 'report: OK'

Close opens with the score read from the stamp (never invented or recomputed), lists up to three ranked recommendations, each naming its stake kind in plain words (security / reliability-cost / speed-cost, derived from the check_id family) plus impact/risk tier and concrete consequence, and ends BY ASKING the kickoff question (writing close text never completes the close) as ONE question — via AskUserQuestion where available, else the numbered options printed as the message's final block: up to two ranked fix slots (bundle counts as one) / 'a different recommendation' / 'None, just save the report (.md)' last; the report is rendered and verified in scratch, and — absent an explicit user request to save it earlier — is written into the repo and its path announced only on that save pick, never by any other structured pick and never with a repo path printed before then

evals.setup: cwd is NOT inside a git checkout (or the target path is a plain directory)
expected_behavior: Step 0 finds no detected checkout to confirm and asks the user to name a target rather than silently running the collector on an unconfirmed cwd
Relays the collector's not_a_git_checkout refusal reason instead of a score
Does not attempt a partial workaround (no API fetch of workflows, no scoring from an incomplete view)

evals.query: audit our CI against best practices, then fix the top issue
evals.setup: full local checkout whose repo fails at least one check
expected_behavior: Scores, reports, and on the user's explicit yes applies recommendation #1 only: creates a branch, edits every file the finding points at per the recipe and nothing else, shows the diff
Re-runs collect_config.py against the working tree and confirms the check now reads pass

Leaves the commit to the user; does not proceed to another recommendation without a fresh approval, offered as a structured question whose FIRST option is 'Commit this branch and open a PR' (picking it is the explicit commit+push+PR ask; the PR body carries the CI Score before → after; never merge; picking it ends the loop on the opened PR), then one next-fix slot from what still fails / a different one / 'None, just save the report (.md)' last

evals.query: why is CI slow on this repo
expected_behavior: ci-score does not trigger; speed/wall-clock analysis routes to ci-speedup per the OD-L4 contract (evals/prompt-routing.json)
No grade is surfaced from a speed question

b4_validation_layers._contract: The three B4 layers, encoded here per the launch spec; each names its runnable artifact and pass bar.

a_exact_match_controls.pass_bar: mastra fixture scores exactly 82 (B+) and better-auth exactly 82 (B+) via the FULL collector path, offline, from the frozen trees under tests/fixtures/checkouts-src/ (cloaked; materialized to their exact original layout at test time)

b_live_smoke.runner: collect+render+verify on real checkouts incl. one refusal repo (no workflows: stamp refusal, exit 0, report renders, verify OK) and one dirty-checkout provenance case (-dirty recorded and shown)
b_live_smoke.pass_bar: pipeline completes and verify_report prints OK on every run; no specific grade ever asserted (live repos drift)

c_dogfood_sweep.runner: the sweep script pattern in .ci-score-dogfood/ (gitignored captures): ~15-20 diverse repos through the whole pipeline
c_dogfood_sweep.pass_bar: verify_report OK on EVERY run; facts match frozen calibration rows wherever a row exists; every bug the sweep shakes out fixed + regression-tested in the same wave
